messages:
Nisha (People Ops): quick heads-up  benefits portal is migrating to BenefitHub on 2026-06-01. Handbook updated: https://handbook.redwood.ai/policies/benefits-migration (see FAQ + timelines)
Omar (Benefits): TL;DR  dental carrier moving from DeltaDental -> BrightSmile, vision and medical unchanged. Existing enrollments will be ported but dependents need re-verification in new portal.
Claire (Finance): payroll note: pre-tax codes will change for the dental plan. Payroll needs final mapping by 2026-05-15 to avoid incorrect deductions. I'll follow up with mapping file.
Ken (People Ops): dependent verification detail: BrightSmile requires a dependent doc upload within 30 days or dependents are dropped. I've added a one-page checklist in the handbook and a template email for managers to help folks.
benefits-bot: Announcement: "Benefits portal migration & dental carrier change" published to all employees. Enrollment window: 2026-05-20 -> 2026-06-05. Auto-migration of basic enrollments begins 2026-05-25.
Nisha (People Ops): action items: 1) Managers please nominate 1 enrollment buddy per team to help employees (sheet: https://sheets.redwood.ai/benefits-buddies) by 2026-05-10. 2) People Ops will host drop-in sessions next week (calendar invite forthcoming). Reply here with "BUDDY SET" or "NEED HELP".
Omar (Benefits): COBRA/termination flows: vendor will send COBRA notices automatically for terminated employees. If you have an offboard in the migration window, tag `benefits-migration` in the offboard ticket so we can escalate.
Claire (Finance): technical: when we get the mapping CSV I'll run `financectl import-benefits-mapping mapping.csv` and run a dry-run. Pls send the mapping to payroll@redwood.ai by Friday.
Ken (People Ops): training: lms-bot will assign a 10-min microlearning "How to use BenefitHub" to everyone; completion required before 2026-05-25 for anyone with dependents or FSA/HSA accounts.
lms-bot: Assigned course: "BenefitHub enrollment guide" to 312 users. Due: 2026-05-25. Link: https://lms.redwood.ai/courses/benefithub-guide
Nisha (People Ops): tracking: we'll run a weekly enrollment progress report and tag managers for non-compliance. Also preparing an internal FAQ doc for common migration errors and rollback steps.
Omar (Benefits): vendor dry-run scheduled 2026-05-18  they'll import a small test batch. If you want your team included in the pilot, reply with "PILOT" and team name.
Claire (Finance): BUDDY SET  payroll mapping owner assigned and I'll validate dry-run results.
Ken (People Ops): BUDDY SET  added eng-frontend buddy @maria.eng. Will run a team drop-in on Thu.
Nisha (People Ops): thanks all  final note: benefits-bot will send reminders for dependent verification 7 days before cutoff. We'll post the short changelog in #docs once pilot completes. :white_check_mark:
